Research / proof of concept. This toolkit ships no game files, assets, keys or CDN content. It only reads files from your own installation and requests public, unauthenticated URLs that the game itself requests. It does not patch, hook or read the memory of the game, its launcher, drivers or anti-cheat. It only delivers texture files the game asks for: it does not touch gameplay or other players and gives no advantage over them. It was built and tested on the single-player campaign; multiplayer and HQ are experimental. Bulk downloads, hosts-file changes and using a local proxy during online play may go against the terms of service where you live or lead to action against your account - that is your call and your responsibility. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Activision. No warranty (MIT license).
